messages:
Ravi (Mkt): Quick sync 17 — Cumulus client story: they agreed to a 25-30m interview next Wed 9:30am PT. Need legal quote approval + asset release. @Priya (Legal) can you advise on language and turnaround?
Eloise (Producer): 9:30 PT works. Planning to record video + capture transcript. Will also grab B-roll of their dashboard if they can screenshare briefly.
Ravi (Mkt): Goal: one long-form case study + a short 60-90s social clip. Key claim we hope to confirm: "Reduced inference cost per request by ~40% while improving 95th percentile latency." Priya, is that okay or need softer wording?
Priya (Legal): Prefer "approximately 40%" and avoid mixing metrics without source. Ask them to confirm the numbers on-record. We need a signed release for the quote, headshot use, and the short clip. TAT 48-72 hrs after we get the exact wording.
Marco (Sales): Post-launch, can we attach a sales enablement one-pager and tag leads with `case:cumulus`? Would be great if web team auto-adds a contact capture flow for inbound demo requests.
Tess (Web): We can add a CTA and hidden utm param. Send the asset and preferred lead tag and we'll queue it for the site sprint.
Eloise (Producer): Draft interview flow: 5m intro, 12-15m Qs, 5m readbacks for quotes, 5m wrap and ask for sign-off. I'll send a consent form and the release checklist to their comms contact.
Ravi (Mkt): Draft quote for confirmation: "Redwood helped us reduce inference cost per request by approximately 40% and improve tail latency across models." Lina (Cumulus) to confirm.
Priya (Legal): Request they confirm exact phrasing in writing (email) and sign the release. I will propose minor phrasing changes: swap "tail latency" to "95th percentile latency" if that's the metric they tracked. Also request the embargo window.
Eloise (Producer): Calendars invite: https://calendar.example.com/invite/ef56  Zoom + local recording. I'll upload raw files to the marketing Drive folder immediately after.
Ravi (Mkt): Embargo requested by client: May 10- May 12. We'll aim for publish May 13 if legal clears.
Marco (Sales): Can ops create a workflow to tag SFDC leads with `case_cumulus` and set lead source = CaseStudy? We also want to add them to the upcoming benchmarking webinar invite list.
Tess (Web): Noted. I added a task to the site backlog with tag `marketing:case-cumulus`.
Priya (Legal): I'll review the quote once Lina emails confirmation. If she includes numbers, ask for backup (screenshot of dashboard or internal report) for our records.
notify-bot: Reminder set 514 Follow up for signed release in 72 hours.
Eloise (Producer): Thanks all. I'll share the pre-interview brief and the recording link after the call. Please flag any additional asks now so I can include them in the brief. :rocket:
